queries: AGI achieved 2026 large language models declared AGI debate
ARC-AGI-3 launch results frontier AI models score humans 100%

sources_considered.why: Reports ARC-AGI-3 launch results (March 2026) showing frontier LLM-based models far below humans; context that AGI is not accepted as achieved.
Primary benchmark page stating the organizers' view that the human-AI gap means AGI is not here.
Secondary report of Jensen Huang saying 'we've achieved AGI' in March 2026; a single executive remark, quickly qualified, is not broad acceptance. Low-quality aggregator.
Personal blog commentary; not a primary source.

receipt.public_excerpt: The ARC Prize Foundation released ARC-AGI-3 on March 24, 2026 — the third iteration of its benchmark designed to measure the gap between current AI and human-level general intelligence. The headline result is damning for frontier AI: humans solve 100% of the environments; the best AI model scores 0.37%.

evidence_items.explanation: Shows that as of 2026 leading LLM-based systems remain far from human performance on a general-intelligence benchmark. This means AGI has not clearly arrived, but it does not show LLMs can never get there.

receipt.public_excerpt: As long as there is a gap between AI and human learning, we do not have AGI.

evidence_items.explanation: The benchmark organizers' position that AGI has not been reached. It is context only: the forecast is about which paradigm reaches AGI, and that event has not happened.

unresolved_gaps: AGI has not been widely accepted as achieved by any system, LLM-based or otherwise, so the forecast has not been tested.
No agreed definition of AGI or of what counts as a 'new paradigm' exists.
